review_evidence: README reports 271 modules formalizing stochastic hybrid systems, PDMP foundations, extended generators, Dynkin formulas and multiple Fokker–Planck/Chapman–Kolmogorov derivations, with no sorry or custom axioms.

265 of 272 Lean files contain proposition declarations, including strong-generator uniqueness, semigroup/resolvent results, Markov-process theorems and formalized corrected/counterexample results from the literature.
The source is overwhelmingly mathematical/probabilistic theorem development and is central corpus material.
summary: Reviewed SHSLib; retain the large stochastic-hybrid-systems and probability formalization.
